errors.evidence: The description incorrectly merges the category label 'Einkommen' with the general x-axis subtitle 'Zufriedenheit mit dem/der...', treating them as a single category name. 'Zufriedenheit mit dem/der ...' is a general label that applies to all four categories on the x-axis, not just 'Einkommen'.

Following the previous error, the description incorrectly assigns the value +0.32 to the non-existent, merged category 'Einkommen Zufriedenheit mit dem/der…'. The value +0.32 actually corresponds to the category 'Einkommen'.
